Who is Ancient Oven?

The, also known as Cherry, is a character in this story. Most of its biography is documented in.

The is a reworked who can be found in the. It was originally a that was used in but was taken by to the during the second. The was later remodeled into the to automate the process of refining for research in order to lessen the load of 's daily routine. He named the machine after his first love.

Eventually, had an idea that could further increase 's capabilities by automating the manufacturing process alongside the refining process, as well as giving it the ability to speak. It wasn't until arrived that she was able to improve 's designs and give it a voice alongside the ability to manufacture ancient equipment. At some point during this time, and got married. After a while, realized that his interactions with and him calling it was hurting, so he took it upon himself to remove it's advanced voice programming and rename it to the. From then on, vowed to stop calling the "" as it would make mad.

When first arrives at the 100 years after the second, the outside the lab is extinguished, making the nonfunctional. During the "," can carry the and relight the to activate the, giving him access to the shop.
